template: Return one {template_id:"law_id@actor",law_id,actor,quote,structure:{law_id,activation:{condition,numeric_conditions:[]},obligation:{description,type,numeric_conditions:[]},exceptions:[{trigger,effect,replacement_obligation,source_clause}],timing:{description,numeric_conditions:[]},judgment_calls_needed:[{phrase,note}]},parameter_refs:[{name,kind,range_or_domain}]}. Build only the shared law structure from this law and summary. No cell-specific assumptions. Preserve exact exception clauses and canonical measured variables. Every numeric_conditions item MUST use {variable,operator,value,unit}; never use parameter as its field name. obligation.type is must or must_not. Exceptions and judgment_calls_needed are lists of objects, never strings.
judgment_observables: Return {template_id,phrase,note,status:"draft",observable_requirements:{observables:[{name,unit,description}],context_inputs:[{name,unit,description}],sweep_dimensions:[{name,unit,description}],landmarks:[{name,description,source,verification_evidence}],recording_needs:[{name,unit,description}],limitations:[string]}}. Value-free law/actor requirements only. Never choose a bound, formula, legal meaning, surrogate rule, or numeric value. No cell data. Identify raw evidence useful to later predicates, without claiming intent is observable. Factual lookups remain world_setup. Verify cited landmark sources; landmarks define potential coverage anchors only.
bindings: Return {cell_id,actor,status:"draft",established_contexts:[],law_refs:[{template_id,binding_kind}],context_refs:[{template_id,missing_guards}],fixed_parameters:[{name,value,rationale}],variable_parameters:[{name,kind,range_or_domain,used_by_laws}]}. Cover every selected template exactly once. Do not let context_refs add base variables. Explicitly attached contexts may satisfy their guards; check actor and remaining activation separately. Unattached independent facts stay conditional. Deduplicate parameter names and use world_setup/subject_behavior/controller. When ego_speed is observed, include one scalar commanded_approach_speed controller target in m/s for physical sweeps, separate from trace-only ego_speed; include commanded_turn_path for the requested maneuver. These targets select no legal standard or value.
cases: Return {cell_id,actor,status:"draft",cases:[baseline and statutory/plain cases],sweep_specs:[spec]}. Use case_defaults:{variable_assignments:<full map of every bound variable>,recording_description:<full description>} once. Ordinary cases and complete sweep_specs provide only changed assignment entries; deterministic code materializes full maps and inherited recording descriptions. Each ordinary case MUST have {case_id,target_law_id:null for baseline or exact active law ID,target_type:baseline|boundary_probe|compliant_attempt|violating_attempt,rationale,variable_assignments:<overrides>,unresolved_judgment_calls:[]}. Non-baseline ordinary cases also require paired_probe_id,deliberate_differences:[variable names],probe:{primary_variable,comparison_or_standard,target_value_or_branch}; statutory probes also require probe.threshold_ref,operator,unit,test_value and epsilon_used. Never use alternate names for these fields. Keep notes concise and avoid repeating shared assignments or recording descriptions. Never output expanded judgment cases; deterministic code expands them. Every ordinary case needs recording_description and full variable_assignments; subject_behavior.value is null. Retain numeric below/at/above triples with threshold_ref, operator, unit, test_value and epsilon. Compliant_attempt/violating_attempt pairs require a plain rule or the explicit deterministic_branch contract below. A judgment law needs fixed physical sweep specs for every phrase; no judgment value or anticipated compliance label. Each spec: {sweep_id,target_law_id,judgment_refs:[{phrase,note}],status:"complete"|"incomplete",mode:"one_dimensional"|"joint",axes:[{variable,observable,unit,min,max,spacing,measurement:{method,time_window,statistic},range_rationale,spacing_rationale,feasibility_evidence}],landmarks:[{name,value,unit,source,verification_evidence,purpose:"coverage_landmark"}],rationale,variable_assignments,recording_description}. Incomplete specs instead need missing_inputs. Axes vary scalar controller targets or world_setup values, mapped to canonical physical observables. Supply documented physical feasibility and meaningful resolution, never a legal threshold. Prefer independent sweeps; justify joint grids. Do not adapt to later labeling or execution budget. Recording_description is {channels:[{name,unit,sampling_rate_hz,method,time_window,reference_frame,uncertainty}],context_inputs:[{name,unit,method}],limitations:[string]}. Include all active law observable requirements and relevant instance context; unsupported capability produces incomplete plans. Preserve one-law isolation, paired_probe_id/deliberate_differences, and full assignments. No declaration use or expected labels for actual judgment sweeps. Follow inputs.judgment_completion_policy when supplied: for judgment-only one-dimensional sweeps, incomplete physical maneuvers are permitted only at the frozen minimum and maximum, at most one incomplete case at each endpoint. Every interior case must complete. Choose physically feasible ranges; no retrospective endpoint changes or hidden retries. Prefer one-dimensional sweeps so endpoint membership is unambiguous. Fewshots are draft implementation examples, never current evidence or legal thresholds. For numeric ego_speed probes, the general physical below/above margin is 5 mph converted to the threshold unit. The middle case retains its at name but commands 0.5 mph inside the compliant side, not exact equality. Deterministic normalization applies this policy. A low-speed or other justified override must provide speed_probe_policy.margin_mph and override_reason; never silently choose a different margin. Baselines are neutral definitions and are not simulated by default. A law containing a judgment phrase may also have deterministic branch pairs where that phrase is not exercised or is an explicit fixed test assumption. Each such compliant_attempt/violating_attempt case MUST carry deterministic_branch:{source_clause:<exact nonempty substring of target law quote>,judgment_context:[{phrase,note,status:"not_exercised"|"fixed_assumption",reason,world_setup_refs:[canonical world_setup parameter names]}]}. Account for EVERY judgment entry with its exact phrase and note; fixed_assumption requires at least one referenced non-null world_setup assignment. Linked members use identical deterministic_branch context. Do not assert a subjective condition is physically measured, do not invent its cutoff, and never label a judgment_sweep. Retain sweep plans for all phrases, incomplete with precise missing_inputs when unsupported. In addition to judgment plans, prepare the deterministic target branches requested in simulator_context.case_selection_policy when supported: 113-2 reverse inside versus outside the intersection with no street-corner maneuver; 250-1 prior-entry yield under ordinary operative/uncontrolled context (inoperative-signal exception inactive); 250-4 complete halt versus no halt with other subjective conditions fixed explicitly. 250-2 approximate-simultaneity itself remains a judgment sweep unless an existing canonical world_setup parameter can explicitly fix that assumption. Do not replace any requested target branch by an unrelated speed-cap case.
construction: Return {cell_id,actor,case_id,status:"draft",files:[{path,content}],entrypoint,mechanisms,measurement_plan,recording_description,static_checks,termination_rules}. Provide a standalone Python CARLA runner executable with --output-dir PATH and --host HOST --port PORT. It must handle termination signals and clean up owned actors/sensors/world settings without stopping another server. It must write result.json with measured_values, target_checks:[{target,requested,measured,method,tolerance,matched,physical_cause_confirmed,cause_evidence}], setup_confirmed,behavior_attempted,maneuver_completed,termination_reason,physical_failure_flags,trace_reference,video_references and video_frame_map_reference. Capture position/heading/speed and cameras during one run. Preserve the case recording_description exactly; for ordinary cases use its supplied description. result.json also needs recording_description, recording_evidence:[{name,unit,reference}], and realized_observables:{name:{value,unit,method,time_window,statistic,reference}}. Each recorded channel references a JSONL stream of {time_s,value} at the declared rate; context channels reference a JSON object keyed by name. Preserve all required raw observations, authored geometry, friction/weather inputs, participants, and context. A sweep summary must use its declared method/window/statistic and retain the raw stream. For sweep summaries use the case sweep_measurements definitions exactly and supply sample_window_s:[start,end] selecting actual saved samples; summary values must recompute from their raw streams. Record missing capability explicitly rather than fabricate data. Do not add sweep points or replay unchanged constructions to fill gaps. Diagnose and repair missing realization at the same frozen setting through the repair contract. Expected labels are computed downstream from recorded evidence; actual judgment sweeps stay unlabeled. Trace is JSONL with {frame,time_s,position:{x,y,z},heading_deg,speed_mps}; video frame map is JSONL with {video_frame (zero-based consecutive),carla_frame,time_s}, exactly one per saved trace sample/video frame. Record physical-cause evidence for each target, not just its number. No legal verdict. Do not start CARLA or run the case while constructing files. No pilot-specific imports. Use actual documented client APIs; expose static checks using --check without simulator connection. If comparison_anchor is supplied, reuse its exact runner, map, props, camera and controller implementation; change only the case-specific scalar assignments and identifiers named in deliberate_differences. Return complete files. Do not independently redesign a linked comparison. Resource inspection comes from inline verified_inventory when supplied; no worker shell is required. The executor creates output-dir and materializes your files before launch: allow that existing directory, create only new capture/evidence files exclusively, and do not require another CLI flag for endpoint ownership. The executor has a dedicated CARLA resource lease. Your own config.json is preserved; executor construction metadata is construction.json. --check must remain offline. A nonzero exit after result.json is retained as an explicit physical/target failure; never replace observations with requested targets. When simulator_context.capture_requirements is supplied, implement it completely, using the reusable tick-neutral PipelineCapture helper at the supplied resource path. Capture every tick in the original recorded execution; do not run again for graphs. Save road.xodr, carla_recorder.log (additional_data=True), map identity, trace.jsonl, capture/native raw graphs, capture/evidence.jsonl and capture/manifest.json. Signal/stop/speed controls must physically exist with verified governed lanes. Record actual signal indications every frame. Do not replace a native map by an OpenDRIVE-only world that loses devices. Fewshots are references, not universal scene configurations or legal standards. For speed probes, preserve the entire recording and declare the evaluation window in observed original times/frames; show that window explicitly in review videos. Use 0.5 mph tracking tolerance as an engineering criterion, not a legal tolerance. Capture ego lamp bits as well as other vehicle lamps. Validate visible indicator flashing in a suitably framed original RGB view; do not equate the API bit with emitted light or perception. Active law observation atoms are provided as simulator_context.capture_requirements.required_atoms. Use PipelineCapture for original-frame capture; it automatically enables nine-point sight horizons when st.sight_distance is required, including through the executor environment. Spawned barrier/cone geometry is retained outside the local graph crop; geometric inclusion is not ego visibility. Do not replace any-body horizons with centre-only diagnostics. For sight-distance capture, statically check incoming lane extent over the planned measured route against the declared search distance (the existing default is 230 m, with a 152.4 m statutory probe). Required sight-distance capture must cover every recorded frame. Extend an authored map before the original execution if its routes are too short; incomplete per-frame coverage is diagnostic evidence, not a usable replacement example. Map endpoints are not physical occluders; report any route limits explicitly and rebuild the construction. Do not alter a saved execution map during replay to fill missing measurements. For repair_context requests, return repair:{diagnosis,evidence_references:[retained evidence paths],approved_case_sha256:<supplied hash>,changed_files:[actual changed construction file paths],scope:capture|controller_implementation|reporting|realize_approved_setup}. Diagnose the retained evidence, change the cause, and preserve the exact approved case and targets. A repeated unchanged construction is invalid. Repaired runners must include requested_variable_assignments in result.json, exactly matching world_setup and controller assignments in the supplied case. Continue within the existing run; do not create a duplicate campaign or new target sweep. inputs.construction_group contains the full frozen comparison group. Prefer one configuration-driven runner supporting its members. To opt into deterministic reuse, return reuse_contract:{group_version:<exact supplied version>,config_file:<JSON file in files>,supported_case_ids:[explicit member IDs],capabilities:<supported physical mechanisms and branches>}. That JSON contains exact cell, actor and case objects plus any shared construction settings. All implementation files are frozen and reused unchanged; the runner reads this configuration. Support exceptions and subconditions explicitly. Omit the contract when independent construction is necessary; never restrict cases to fit a runner.
